resources.string: This practicum introduces the fundamentals of Android application development using Android Studio. Each meeting adds one topic, from the first Hello, World! app to tab layouts, menus, and custom styles. The course is part of the Software Engineering Technology program, Vocational School, Universitas Gadjah Mada.
